subject: MedCure: security-led subsidy pathway for private VPC trial
messages:
From: Julie Nguyen <julie.nguyen@medcure.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.example.com
Cc: security@medcure.com; procurement@medcure.com
Date: 2025-07-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Trial & compliance path for private deployment

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team reviewed the hosted demo and is generally positive, but because this POC will touch PHI-adjacent datasets we need the trial to run in an isolated VPC and to see the following before we can accept any promotional credits:

- SOC 2 Type II attestation (redacted OK)
- Network diagram showing isolated Egress/Ingress controls
- Data retention and deletion policy for KV cache and logs

Can Redwood support a 60–90 day private VPC sandbox with sponsored credits while we validate controls? Procurement also asked for an outline of billing cadence and a statement of work.

I've attached the security checklist our team filled out (see security@medcure.com for internal notes).

Julie Nguyen
Head of Product Security, MedCure
julie.nguyen@medcure.com

Attachment: medcure-security-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
To: Julie Nguyen <julie.nguyen@medcure.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com; aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
Date: 2025-07-20T12:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Trial & compliance path for private deployment

Julie — thanks for the clear checklist and the context. We're keen to support MedCure's VPC POC. Proposed pathway: 

1) Redwood provides a conditional credit sponsorship (up to $12k of credits) tied to evidence submission and a 60–90 day private VPC sandbox.
2) Security evidence we need to review before credits are applied:
   - Redacted SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
   - High-level network diagram (customer-facing PNG/PDF)
   - Confirmation of datasets to be used (PII/PHI flags)
3) Procurement: we'll provide an SOW and a short addendum documenting the subsidy and billing hold. Billing will be paused for the sponsored credit period; normal invoicing resumes once credits exhaust or trial ends.

I've attached a short term-sheet and a checklist of the technical artifacts that gets us to approval. If you can share the SOC2 + diagram we'll fast-track the security review.

Next steps: Julie to share SOC2 redacted + diagram; Redwood (Karthik) to complete security intake within 48 business hours; Finance (Aditya) to confirm subsidy sign-off.

—Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Eng, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.example.com
Attachment: redwood-private-poc-subsidy-term-sheet.pdf (1 page)
From: Julie Nguyen <julie.nguyen@medcure.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.example.com
Cc: security@medcure.com; procurement@medcure.com
Date: 2025-07-22T08:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Trial & compliance path for private deployment

Laura — attaching the SOC2 (redacted) and our two-page network diagram. Procurement asked whether Redwood can extend the trial window to 90 days instead of 60; given internal timelines that would be ideal.

Also copied in our procurement contact: procurement@medcure.com for SOW/billing coordination. If there's anything in the SOC2 that triggers follow-up, please call out exact sections so we can escalate with our auditors.

Attachments: MedCure_SOC2_Type2_redacted.pdf, medcure-sys-arch.png

Julie

On Tue, Jul 22, 2025 at 07:50, security@medcure.com wrote:
> Hi Laura/Redwood — quick note: our expectation is that the vendor maintains deleted KV cache within 30 days and provides an auditable deletion log. Happy to align on the format.
>
> —MedCure Security
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.example.com; karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com
Cc: Julie Nguyen <julie.nguyen@medcure.com>; procurement@medcure.com
Date: 2025-07-23T15:20:00Z
Subject: Fwd: MedCure SOC2 + network diagram — request for subsidy approval and billing hold

Team — forwarding MedCure's artifacts. They're requesting a 90-day isolated VPC trial with sponsored credits. Key asks from security: auditable deletion logs for KV cache and confirmation of egress restrictions (no external S3 endpoints except customer-managed storage). Procurement wants an SOW and billing cadence.

Proposal for internal approval: offer a conditional 90-day subsidy capped at $12k provided: SOC2 redacted received (done), network diagram approved (looks good), and security sign-off on deletion/log format (Karthik to confirm). We'll enter a billing hold for the duration; any usage beyond credits billed normally.

Questions for Aditya: do we have margin flexibility for a $12k demo subsidy on Dedicated/Private hosting? Could we add a standard clause limiting support to P0 only and requiring a paid uplift for production?

If you approve, I'll send a short subsidy addendum + SOW to procurement and ask Karthik to complete the security intake.

—Laura

Attachment referenced: MedCure_SOC2_Type2_redacted.pdf
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.example.com; karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com
Cc: Julie Nguyen <julie.nguyen@medcure.com>; procurement@medcure.com
Date: 2025-07-25T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: MedCure SOC2 + network diagram — request for subsidy approval and billing hold

Laura/Karthik — approve a conditional subsidy but adjust to 60 days and $8k cap. Rationale: typical POC churn and to keep program consistent. Approve earlier payment hold and SOW workflow. Approvals conditional on:

- Karthik confirms auditable deletion log format and signs off security intake (48h).
- Procurement signs subsidy addendum with liability cap and support limits (P0 only during trial).

If Security signs the deletion format and Procurement accepts the addendum, finance will provision the $8k credit and set billing to hold for that amount. If MedCure strongly needs 90 days, we can offer a one-time 30-day extension after a milestone (technical validation) at Redwood's discretion.

I'll loop Legal if they ask for contract language changes.

- Aditya Rao
Director, Customer Finance, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.example.com
